decisions.reason: As a core cutting and creasing finisher with an established product page, it fits the firm's automated finishing portfolio and is more likely to be retained after the 2024 pruning of less fitting products.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship, strategically aligned with the firm's direction toward higher-format automated finishing, so withdrawal within the next year is very unlikely.
The hybrid saddle stitcher remains well within the firm's booklet-making and binding competence and supports its broad postpress offer, making continued marketing the sensible choice.
Although it is less prominently marketed, the folding add-on extends existing modular systems and has demonstrated customer use, so it is still more likely to stay than to be withdrawn.
